source_title: 42 Celebrity Halloween Costumes That Are Easy to Recreate - People.com
source_excerpt:
As if Lupita Nyong’o’s ‘Clueless’ ensemble isn’t an easy look to recreate for spooky season
Catherine Santino is a Style Writer-Reporter at PEOPLE. She began contributing to PEOPLE in 2022 and joined the staff full time in 2024. Her work has previously appeared in The Zoe Report, Popsugar, Insider and more.
Taylor Hill/FilmMagic ; Andrew Lipovsky/NBC/NBCU Photo Bank via Getty
Who says a Halloween costume has to be complicated?
We love the intricate looks Heidi Klum creates each spooky season , but not every un-boo-liveable look needs to cost a ton of money or require four people to pull off . After all, while it’s fun to party or trick-or-treat in elaborate looks, they’re not always realistic to replicate.
Believe it or not, celebrities are the perfect mood board for easy costume inspirations . Whether they’re sharing a themed photo shoot on Instagram or attending a spooktacular party , stars have debuted some seriously simple — and often iconic — Halloween costumes over the years.
Whether you’re looking for something on the creepy and kooky side or something to show off your love of pop culture , these stars have done it all, from Lupita Nyong’o ’s anything but “whatever” Clueless costume and Lily Allen ’s cheeky Madeline to Kristen Stewart ’s bloody baseball player to Zoë Kravitz ’s eerie-sistable zombie.
Here are some quick, easy celebrity costume ideas for Halloween inspired by some fang-tastic ensembles.
Lily Allen as Madeline from the Madeline book series
Allen made a cheeky nod to her song “ Madeline ” — a tune off her 2025 album West End Girl in which the narrator confronts a woman named Madeline who slept with her husband — by dressing up as the children’s book character of the same name while stepping out for a Halloween party in Los Angeles in 2025.
The base of the look is a light blue A-line coat paired with a red scarf and bag, topped off with a straw hat, black Mary Janes and white socks.
Joe Jonas and Sophie Turner as Gomez and Morticia Addams from The Addams Family
For a couples costume idea, take inspiration from Joe Jonas and Sophie Turner ’s 2018 Halloween celebrations. The exes — who finalized their divorce in September 2024 — dressed as Gomez and Morticia Addams from the 1991 film The Addams Family . Turner wore a simple black dress and long black wig, while Jonas looked dapper in a pinstripe suit, slicked-back hair and a thin mustache.
Lily Collins as Baby Spice and Posh Spice
Why dress up like one Spice Girl when you can be two? Fangirl Lily Collins paid homage to both Emma Bunton and Victoria Beckham in 2024, sharing on Instagram: “Started the day as Baby and ending as Posh. Spicing up my life this Halloween...”
You won’t feel like a “ wannabe ” when you recreate one or both — for Baby Spice, the Emily in Paris star paired a black Spice Girls tee with high-rise ‘90s jeans and tossed a long blonde wig into ponytails, while for Posh Spice, a sleek black suit and her natural dark bob did the trick. Don’t forget to pose!
Selena Quintanilla ’s stage looks were as iconic as her music, particularly her affinity for bustier tops . In 2016, Keke Palmer attended Just Jared’s annual Halloween party dressed as the late Tejano singer, wearing an embellished bustier, high-waisted black pants and a black cap. She finished the look with Quintanilla’s signature red lipstick and oversized hoop earrings.
Emily Ratajkowski as Marge Simpson from The Simpsons
Emily Ratajkowski ’s interpretation of Marge Simpson from The Simpsons at Klum’s 2015 Heidi Halloween was perfectly zany. Aside from tracking down a tall blue wig, all you’ll need to recreate this costume is a green strapless dress, a beaded necklace and red shoes — and, if you’re really committed, some yellow body paint.
Kristen Stewart as a bloody baseball player
In 2019, Stewart appeared on The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon in a simple yet spooky costume: a baseball uniform and hat splattered with blood, which she also painted onto her face.
Nyong’o embraced ‘90s fashion at Klum’s 19th annual Halloween party in 2018. The Odyssey actress dressed as Dionne Davenport ( Stacey Dash ), the Clueless character who famously wore a black-and-white plaid ensemble similar to Cher’s iconic yellow look .
Pair the jacket and skirt with a red cardigan, knee-high socks and a hat, and you’ll instantly emulate the Y2K schoolgirl style. Nyong’o added an oversized ‘90s cell phone covered in crystals for a touch of glamour.
Busy Philipps as Regina George’s mom from Mean Girls
Mean Girls fans will instantly recognize the pink sweatsuit, video camera and cocktail glass combination as Regina George ’s mother ( Amy Poehler ) from the 2004 cult classic. In 2019, Busy Philipps dressed as the hilarious “cool” mom, showing off her costume in a series of Instagram photos . Incidentally, Philipps was cast in the exact role for 2024’s Mean Girls musical film adaptation .
Joe Keery as Harry Potter from the Harry Potter movie series
While attending Just Jared’s 2017 Halloween party in Beverly Hills, Joe Keery proved it’s wonderfully simple to get to Hogwarts. All that’s needed to dress up like Harry Potter is a white collared shirt, maroon-and-yellow tie, vest, black robe, a pair of glasses and a lightning bolt scar drawn on your forehead.
Kaia Gerber looked straight out of the disco era at the 2017 Casamigos Halloween Party, the annual bash thrown by The Shards star’s father and Casamigos tequila co-founder, Rande Gerber . To recreate a similar look, you’ll need a glittery halter top, miniskirt and platform heels. For makeup, try bold eyelashes and colorful eyeshadow that match your outfit.
Ben Platt as the Tin Man and Beanie Feldstein as Dorothy from The Wizard of Oz
Few characters are as beloved as those from 1939’s The Wizard of Oz , making for reliable costume ideas year after year. For Bette Midler ’s 2019 Hulaween event, Beanie Feldstein and Ben Platt looked adorable as Dorothy and the Tin Man.
Feldstein’s costume consisted of a blue-and-white checkered dress, white button-up shirt, tiny picnic basket purse and Dorothy’s iconic ruby slippers with ruffly white ankle socks, while Platt wore a metallic jumpsuit and matching shoes, plus some silver face paint for good measure.
In 2018, Nicky Hilton attended the Casamigos Halloween party dressed as her sister Paris Hilton . The heiress specifically referenced Paris’ sparkly 21st birthday look , donning a similar metallic cowl-neck dress with a crystal choker necklace and a tiara.
Kravitz’s vampire costume for Halloween 2018 was nothing short of unique. Instead of traditional undead garb, the How to Rob a Bank actress wore a bathrobe, tossed a towel around her head and carried a coffee mug and a morning paper, proving supernatural creatures dislike early mornings as much as mortals.
Elsa Hosk ’s 2019 Halloween costume for Klum’s 20th annual Heidi Halloween party was inspired by Natalie Portman ’s character Alice Ayres from 2004’s Closer . The main elements include a bright pink wig, fringe top, miniskirt and platform heels. Even if no one understands the movie reference, this is still a fun look for Halloween night!
For a sultry spin on circus fashion, Lily-Rose Depp appeared at the 2018 V Magazine Halloween Party dressed as a ringmaster . She paired black tights with a white collared shirt and a fitted red blazer, then accessorized with a staff, knee-high boots and fingerless gloves.
Georgia Fowler as Holly Golightly from Breakfast at Tiffany’s
At Klum’s 20th annual Halloween party in 2019, Georgia Fowler paid homage to Audrey Hepburn ’s iconic portrayal of Holly Golightly in 1961’s Breakfast at Tiffany’s . To recreate the look, you’ll need a black dress, an updo (or wig) and a cigarette holder. For extra detail, carry a coffee cup and croissant like the character does in the movie.
Nina Dobrev nailed Billie Eilish ’s signature look at the 2019 Casamigos Halloween Party. Between The Vampire Diaries alum’s spot-on oversized Louis Vuitton sweatshirt and matching shorts, temporarily green-tinted roots and black tear streaks, the ensemble was a dead giveaway for Eilish’s “ Bad Guy ” era. This costume is not only easy to achieve, but probably pretty comfortable, too.
When it comes to glamorous Halloween costume ideas, Marilyn Monroe is a no-brainer, and Cindy Crawford dressed as the late icon while appearing on a Halloween episode of The Tonight Show with Jay Leno in 1996. The supermodel wore pretty much the only two things you need to recreate her look: a white dress and a blonde wig. It doesn’t hurt to add some red lipstick and sparkly jewelry.
Kim Kardashian as Elle Woods from Legally Blonde
Considering her pursuits in the legal field , it made perfect sense for Kim Kardashian to dress up as Elle Woods ( Reese Witherspoon ) in 2019. A pink dress, heart-shaped necklace and blonde wig are the heavy hitters of this Legally Blonde look.
The mom of four accessorized with a real-life dog as Woods’ furry companion, Bruiser, but a stuffed animal would also do the trick.
Harry Styles went as the “Rocket Man” himself for Halloween 2018. At the Casamigos Halloween Party, the “ Aperture ” singer wore an embellished L.A. Dodgers baseball uniform, a replica of the ensemble Elton John wore for his concerts at Dodger Stadium in 1975.
Any baseball uniform would probably get the point across, though we’d recommend adding sequins. Plus, don’t forget the most important element of the look: brightly colored tinted sunglasses.
Allison Williams as Belle from Beauty and the Beast
There’s no denying the magic and fun of Disney-inspired Halloween costumes! In 2015, Girls actress Allison Williams traversed the N.Y.C. subway system dressed as Belle from 1991’s Beauty and the Beast , looking uncannily similar to the princess. A simple blue dress, white blouse and white apron make up the base of the ensemble, and a hair ribbon, wicker basket and open book are the perfect additions.
Why wouldn’t Beyoncé have a halo? In 2013, the “ Texas Hold ‘Em ” singer shared her angelic look on Instagram , complete with a fuzzy halo over her head and angel wings. To complete your angel costume, don that classic accessory duo with a white dress and some sparkly makeup.
Gigi Hadid arrived at Klum’s annual Halloween party in 2015 in the sexy ensemble Sandy Olsson (originated by the late Olivia Newton-John) wears at the end of 1978’s Grease . The simple costume consists of three key black pieces — a leather jacket, pants and a crop top — paired with red heels and a curly blonde wig.
If you’re not into spooky Halloween looks, go for a flouncy Fairy Godmother moment as Martha Stewart did for Hub Network’s first annual Halloween Bash in 2013. Her pink tulle dress is quite the showstopper, but any pastel frock works (though the fluffier, the better). Add a tiara and wand, and you’ll look like you stepped right out of a fairy tale.
Travis Barker and Kourtney Kardashian as Sid Vicious and Nancy Spungen
For Halloween 2021, Travis Barker and Kourtney Kardashian dressed as the late Sex Pistols bassist Sid Vicious and his girlfriend Nancy Spungen. To portray the couple , the Poosh founder paired a mesh T-shirt with a dark bra, studded leather pants and a curly blonde wig, while the Blink-182 drummer wore a leather jacket, skinny jeans and a spiked black wig.
Zac Posen as Willy Wonka from Willy Wonka and the Chocolate Factory
For Klum’s 2018 Halloween party, designer Zac Posen dressed as the whimsical Willy Wonka from Willy Wonka & the Chocolate Factory — specifically, Gene Wilder ‘s portrayal in the 1971 film. To recreate the look, you’ll need a rust-colored top hat, purple coat, waist coat, tan chinos and a bow tie.
Rihanna ‘s makeup skills came in handy in 2018 when she attended a Halloween party in London in a skeleton costume. She was seen wearing a corseted latex ensemble and neon pink face makeup, plus a pair of sunglasses. You don’t have to go for as much detail to recreate Rihanna’s look, as any black outfit and skeleton makeup will give you plenty of leeway to put your own spin on the look.
Joe Jonas as Derek Zoolander from Zoolander
At Klum’s 15th annual Halloween party in 2014, Jonas appeared as Ben Stiller ’s iconic titular character from the 2001 film Zoolander . Along with a patterned shirt and matching headband, the Jonas Brothers singer even posed for the cameras, emulating Zoolander’s signature “ blue steel ” face.
Pokémon fans will appreciate Jhené Aiko ’s 2019 Halloween costume as Ash Ketchum, the franchise’s protagonist. The singer wore denim jean shorts with a black crop top, blue-and-white cropped jacket and red-and-white hat, à la the animated character. She expertly completed the look with a mini stuffed Pikachu perched on her shoulder.
Paying tribute to the late R&B singer , Zendaya attended Keep a Child Alive’s 20th annual Dream Halloween event in 2013 as Aaliyah . To embody the musician, the Euphoria actress wore a long, sleek hairstyle with side bangs, low-waisted jeans with Tommy Hilfiger underwear peeking out, a cropped Tommy Hilfiger top and a red jacket with the sleeves pushed up.
No one goes quite as full-out as Klum on Halloween, but among her elaborate costumes , this one is one of the easier ones to recreate. For this evil twist on Betty Boop , you’ll need a red minidress, matching heels, satin gloves and a black curly updo. To double down on the spooky twist, add vampire teeth or fake blood.
Cindy Crawford as a 1960s flight attendant
En route to the 2018 Casamigos Halloween Party in Las Vegas, Crawford dressed like a 1960s flight attendant. To recreate this retro ensemble, you’ll need a sheath dress, a pillbox hat and a voluminous hairstyle. If props are your thing, carry around a serving tray of drinks.
Kerry Washington as Seong Gi-hun from Squid Game
Squid Game had such a massive cultural impact that you’d be hard-pressed to find anyone who doesn’t immediately recognize the teal-and-white jumpsuits the characters wear throughout the nail-biting South Korean thriller series. In 2021, during the height of the show’s popularity, Kerry Washington rocked short hair and dressed as the main character, Seong Gi-hun ( Lee Jung-jae ).
Because each player is assigned a number when they enter the Squid Game, it’s easy to dress as any of the show’s characters by creating a tag with their player number and sticking it on your jumpsuit.
After The Weeknd called out how much he thinks he and Trevor Noah look alike, the former Daily Show host responded by portraying the singer for Halloween 2021, joking on X (formerly Twitter) that he was “The Weekday.” You don’t have to be a doppelganger to dress like the “ Blinding Lights ” singer — you need a red blazer, a black shirt and a pair of sunglasses to recreate his After Hours - era look.
It’s safe to say the award for the most unexpected costume (and one of the funniest) of 2019 went to Dakota Fanning , who went as a fluffy shower loofah. If you’re inspired by the squeaky-clean look, squeeze into any tulle minidress. For authenticity, add a product tag on the side of your costume as Fanning did. Her rubber-ducky headband is also a nice touch.
Cardi B as Cruella de Vil from One Hundred and One Dalmatians
For the 2017 Dress to Be Free Halloween Party in N.Y.C., Cardi B went as one of Disney’s most notorious villains , wearing Cruella de Vil ’s signature half-white, half-black hairstyle and a dramatic fur cape.
The “ AH HA ” rapper completed the look with a cigarette holder, which is all you really need to recreate this look. While Cardi’s ‘do is likely a wig, you can also use temporary hair dye if you’re feeling ambitious.
Jonathan Cheban and Kim Kardashian as Sonny and Cher
With pal Jonathan Cheban by her side, dressed as Sonny Bono , Kim dressed as Cher for the 2017 Casamigos Halloween Party. While the SKIMS founder was replicating the music icon’s exact look from the 1973 Academy Awards , any ‘70s-inspired ensemble would do the trick — just don’t forget the long black wig for Cher and the mustache for Bono.
Kaia was almost unrecognizable as rocker Joan Jett at the 2018 Casamigos Halloween Party. To copy her look, rock leather pants, a black tee, combat boots and plenty of chain jewelry. A black wig and dark smoky eye makeup will complete the effect.
Few things are as iconic as referencing your own hit song in your Halloween costume, and that’s just what Lizzo did in 2019, dressing as a DNA test in a nod to the memorable line in her chart-topping track “ Truth Hurts .” The ensemble included a placard that the singer wore over the front of her body and a giant sparkly cotton swab, making for a creative and very recreatable DIY costume.
At the annual Casamigos Halloween Party in L.A. in 2023, Justin Bieber got aquatic, dressing as a scuba diver . This effortless, beachy outfit only requires three items: comfortable swimwear, flippers and a snorkel set. May we suggest a waterproof bag for that phone, though?
Mariah Carey as Jessica Rabbit from Who Framed Roger Rabbit
Mariah Carey dazzled as Jessica Rabbit from 1988’s Who Framed Roger Rabbit , bringing the sultry animated character to life for Halloween 2023. To recreate the costume, slip on a form-fitting red sequined gown and long purple gloves, then top off the look with a wavy red wig to capture the character’s iconic allure.
Lauren Conrad and friends as “party animals”
Who doesn’t love a punny costume? This 2015 group costume from Lauren Conrad and her friends was equal parts adorable and creative. All you’ll need is a party dress, a pair of animal ears and a little bit of makeup.
